notes.title: New Cover Art and Indie Route Event
notes.content:
Greetings! I hope you all are doing well and enjoying the summer! 

I have great news! The new Cover Art made my Amir Zand / https://www.artstation.com/amirzand /
finished this week and im very happy to share it with you! He did an amazing work and im very proud of it. First it was very hard to find any artist that would work for my indie game. Everybody was very busy and most of them just didnt bother to reply. So after long time looking I found Amir on ArtStation and loved his work so much! Well I did not actually believe that he wanted to work for me so here is a big thank to him! You can watch some of his great work at his page on artstation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270496/bc24785e9d33b8959296a752b381f1d161d744a5.jpg[/img]

Later in June I was showcased in Indie Route Event and I also was streaming it. It was very nice! It wasnt that popular, the youtube channel was very new and had very small subs. But still it was very big for me! I also showed some of the first levels of the game and you might be interested in seeing it.

[previewyoutube=JehBhqBNx3s;full][/previewyoutube]

Currently im finishing the first misson entry and going to work on the space combat missions! Here is a cool gif where the recruits have to make a line but it was more of a banana line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270496/3a5cc70bf6e1b372d02664c9cce72391a213b456.gif[/img]

So make sure to follow the next updates!

See you soon
Wladimir Kiselew | Lewzilla

notes.title: More progress within the space station - RPG part -
notes.content:
Hello there pilots! I hope you are enjoying the upcoming summer.

This week I was working to upgrade the rest of the sprites to the newest version. Im very happy with the result. There are still some small things to tweak. But overall all the base is finished and Im happy to share two screenshot. Sadly it wont fit easy into the whole scene but you still can see some parts of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270496/879594b27edb70698656eb6d10750f7adfe23805.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270496/ba207beadcfec6586b48b96a012c1131895fe4fe.jpg[/img]

The next goal is to finish two main rooms and start filling the space station with NPC's. The two rooms will be a space bar called Lew's Heaven and the right room will be the general office. I also plan to give the player a personal room, where after future progress he will get a bigger room with some small interactions. But first things first.

Here is my second big progress that im very proud of. The room transition:
[previewyoutube=ka4IrdoDeEY;full][/previewyoutube]

Right now the space bar is kind of a filler to give more life to the space station. I have way more ideas for it! The goal will be that the player can talk to other NPC's there, gather some informations, get some side quests. Maybe reveal important secrets. Or just hang a bit and play some small arcade games and hear the music. One small game that I want to create is a dance game where you know from many arcade places. This would be very cool.

Well! See you soon.

Sincerely
Wladimir Kiselew | Lewzilla

notes.title: Im happy to share my newest progress #1
notes.content:
Hello there pilots! I hope you are doing well!

Im very eager to share my progess.

For many days I bumped my head for this thing. I wanted to have different background soundeffect when the player enters a different location. Say you are in a flying ship and enter a mechanical room. You should hear the loud working engine and computers. But I had this very strange error. When I changed the audio you would hear a very strange crackling noice. And it made me crazy. But after many days I finally found a smooth solution. And here is the result:
[previewyoutube=WdDQcHgP7vk;full][/previewyoutube]

Currently im updating my whole graphical sprites to the newer ones. When I started creating the idea for the game I could not find any good graphical assets for my sicfi space station. So I found this very basic and cool looking sprites for free. When the same artist found my game on the internet he told me that he actually upgraded them for me, and this in his free time. I was so amazed by that and I was speechless!
Here you can see the difference:
[previewyoutube=OW6NBxA9C9g;full][/previewyoutube]


I hope you liked it and I wish you a good time!

Sincerely
Wladimir Kiselew | Lewzilla
